To render:   quarto render 265_typst_example.qmd

```{=typst}
#import "@preview/fletcher:0.5.8" as fletcher: diagram, node, edge
```
Comment
```{=typst}
/*
a long comment

*/

```

Diagram, includes nodes and edges
- Use backslash to linebreak \
```{=typst}
#diagram(cell-size: 15mm, $
	G edge(f, ->) edge("d", pi, ->>) & im(f) \
	G slash ker(f) edge("ur", tilde(f), "hook-->")
$)\
```

#### experiment
```{=typst}
#diagram(cell-size: 15mm, $
	A edge(f, ->) edge("d", pi, ->>) & B edge(g, ->) & C edge(h, -> ) & D
$)\
```

### linear
```{=typst}
#diagram(
$
A edge("wave") &
B edge("zigzag") &
C edge("coil") & D \
alpha &&& omega \
a edge(g, ->) & b
$
)\
```


```{=typst}
#diagram(
debug: true, // show a coordinate grid
spacing: (5pt, 4em), // small column gaps, large row spacing
node((0,0), $f$),
node((1,0), $f$, stroke: 1pt),
node((2,0), $f$, stroke: blue, shape: rect),
)\
```

### Add vertical space
```{=typst}
A
#v(1cm)
B\
```


```{=typst}

#set align(center)
#block(
  fill: rgb("f58025"),
  inset: 14pt,
  width: 100%,
[Can use typ file, but then use `typst` ecosystem to render]
)

```

## Linear Algebra

### with special symbols
```{=typst}
$
forall v, w in V, alpha in KK: alpha dot (v + w) = alpha v + alpha w
$
```

### unicode

$$
∀ v, w ∈ V, α ∈ 𝕂: α ⋅ (v + w) = α v + α w
$$
